subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board continued a public hearing for a proposed 350-unit 40B residential development, reviewing site design and community feedback while awaiting peer review reports. No final votes were taken, and the hearing was continued to February 6, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Continued Hearing
items.summary: The board resumed consideration of a comprehensive permit for an eight-story apartment development consisting of two buildings on three acres.

items.title: Ground Floor Retail and Amenities
items.summary: Board members questioned the placement of the leasing office and the size of the 2,000-square-foot retail space intended to activate the Mystic Valley Parkway frontage.

items.title: Landscape Design Presentation
items.summary: The applicant presented a conceptual landscape plan featuring a public pocket park at the corner of Commercial Street and private courtyards for residents.

items.title: Transportation and Parking Utilization
items.summary: Discussion focused on a proposed private commuter shuttle to Wellington Station and the use of parking utilization studies to justify the requested parking ratios.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Opened and closed public comment without testimony as no members of the public requested to speak.

items.title: Peer Review Timeline and Documentation Requests
items.summary: The board requested shadow studies and an updated waiver list to reflect new zoning, noting that peer review reports are expected in approximately four weeks.

items.title: Building Commissioner Regulatory Review
items.summary: The Building Commissioner noted that proposed balconies must not encroach into the public right-of-way and requested clarified site plan dimensions.
